authorization.source: Direct user answer in this task; supersedes prior LUT 80 percent gate only
authorization.instruction: 允许超过 80%，但必须在器件容量内完成布局布线，并且全部时序通过，并且要尽可能占用少的资源，优化的越小越好。

note: Area acceptance alone never authorizes bitgen. Native packing limits and strict routed STA remain mandatory. Historical 80 percent results retain their original policy.
